story.secondBody: With our Full Scale Project model, you don’t manage a patchwork of specialists. You get one integrated team that covers every discipline — architecture, design, digital, and business strategy — with a single point of contact, a unified timeline, and total accountability from start to finish.

accordionItems.title: Who We Are
accordionItems.content: We’re a multidisciplinary firm based in Wyoming, USA, operating globally across architecture, design, and digital development. One company, one culture, one standard of quality — applied across every discipline we cover.

accordionItems.title: Our Commitment
accordionItems.content: We believe great projects fail at the seams — the gaps between teams, vendors, and disciplines. Our model eliminates those seams. One contract, one point of contact, one team accountable for the whole.

accordionItems.title: Our Approach
accordionItems.content: We start by listening. Every Full Scale Project begins with a deep-dive discovery session — not a sales pitch. We map your goals, your constraints, and your timeline before we propose a single solution. Then we build around what you actually need.

questions.question: Q1: What exactly is a Full Scale Project?
questions.answer: It’s our all-in-one engagement model where a single MyDesign3D team handles architecture, design, development, and business strategy under one contract, one timeline, and one point of contact. You stop coordinating vendors; we handle everything.

questions.question: Q2: How long does a Full Scale Project typically take?
questions.answer: It depends on scope. A digital + branding project typically runs 6–12 weeks. A full architecture + digital engagement can range from 3 to 12 months. We define the exact timeline during the discovery phase before any commitment.

questions.question: Q3: Do I need to use all disciplines, or can I pick specific ones?
questions.answer: You can. The Full Scale model is our flagship offering, but we also work on individual discipline projects. If you only need a web platform or only architectural design, we can scope that separately.

questions.question: Q4: What types of clients do you work with?
questions.answer: We work with startups, real estate developers, enterprises, and entrepreneurs across industries — from retail and hospitality to tech and professional services. If your project requires multiple disciplines, we’re built for it.

questions.question: Q5: How is pricing structured?
questions.answer: We provide fixed-price proposals based on scope — no hourly billing surprises. Every proposal includes a full breakdown by discipline, milestone, and deliverable. Consultation is always free.
